grammar_concept.title: Present Simple for Routines
grammar_concept.rule: Use the Present Simple to talk about habits, routines and facts. Add -s (or -es) to the verb with he/she/it.
grammar_concept.simple_explanation: We use this tense for things that happen regularly — not just now, but again and again (every day, every week).
grammar_concept.example: She works at a bank. I get up at 7am every day.
grammar_concept.example_translation: Ela trabalha num banco. Eu levanto-me às 7h todos os dias.
grammar_concept.common_mistake_pt: Falantes de português tendem a esquecer o -s na 3ª pessoa do singular (he/she/it), porque em português essa marcação não é obrigatória na mesma posição: dizem "She work" em vez de "She works".
grammar_concept.correction: Add -s to the base verb whenever the subject is he, she or it: work → works, go → goes, study → studies.
grammar_concept.real_world_example: In a work email: "My manager usually reviews reports on Fridays."

example_sentences: I wake up at 6:30 every morning.

vocabulary.definition_en: to eat the first meal of the day
example_sentences: I have breakfast before I leave for work.

vocabulary.definition_en: to travel regularly between home and work
example_sentences: She commutes to the office by train.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence: She ___ (work) at a bank.
exercises.explanation: 3ª pessoa do singular (he/she/it) leva -s no Present Simple.
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Falantes de português esquecem frequentemente o -s final nesta posição.

correct_answer: He goes to the gym on Mondays.
distractors: He go to the gym on Mondays.
He going to the gym on Mondays.
He is go to the gym on Mondays.
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Uso do gerúndio ("going") em vez do Present Simple, por transferência do português "está a ir".

correct_answer: to travel regularly between home and work
exercises.explanation: "Commute" refere-se especificamente à deslocação regular entre casa e trabalho.

exercises.prompt: Listen to the audio. What time does Anna wake up?
exercises.explanation: No áudio, Anna diz: "I wake up at 7am every day."
exercises.transcript: Anna wakes up at seven a.m. every day, has breakfast, and then commutes to work by train.

exercises.prompt: Read the text: "Anna wakes up at 7am. She has breakfast and commutes to the office by train. She usually gets to work at 9am." What time does Anna get to work?
exercises.explanation: O texto indica diretamente "gets to work at 9am".

exercises.prompt: Translate to English: "Ela acorda às 7h e toma o pequeno-almoço antes de sair para o trabalho."
correct_answer: She wakes up at 7am and has breakfast before she leaves for work.
exercises.explanation: Atenção ao -s em "wakes" e "has" (3ª pessoa do singular).
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Esquecer o -s em ambos os verbos é o erro mais comum nesta frase.

steps.content: Practise the -s ending sound: works /wɜːks/, goes /ɡoʊz/, watches /ˈwɒtʃɪz/ — three different sounds depending on the final letter of the verb.

steps.prompt: Describe your typical weekday morning in 3-4 sentences using the Present Simple.
Write 5 sentences about your daily routine using the Present Simple.
